verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke nana a da reyọ Josẹf vwo kpo Ijipt, kọye Potifa, onotu ri Fero, olori rẹ ihwo re rhẹrẹ, okpuyovwi rọye ohwo rẹ Ijipt, da dẹ mie ihwo rẹ Ishmael ri ghoro rhe.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana a da reyo josef vwo kpo ijipt koye potifa onotu ri fero olori re ihwo re rhere okpuyovwi roye ohwo re ijipt da de mie ihwo re ishmael ri ghoro rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo vi Josẹf herọ, ọ da rhe dia omamọ rẹ ohwo kẹ uwevwi rẹ onini rọye rẹ ohwo rẹ Ijipt na.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo vi josef hero o da rhe dia omamo re ohwo ke uwevwi re onini roye re ohwo re ijipt na

verses.text_urhobo: Onini rọye da mrẹ vughe nẹ Ọrovwohwo vọye herọ, nẹ Ọrovwohwo re jabọ rẹ obo rọye ruẹ ejobi vwo yovwi kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: onini roye da mre vughe ne orovwohwo voye hero ne orovwohwo re jabo re obo roye rue ejobi vwo yovwi ke

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ọ da vwẹ aruesiri vwo ni Josẹf ọ da vwẹ ẹro te, o de vwo mu osun rẹ uwevwi rọye kugbe emu ro vwori ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: koye o da vwe aruesiri vwo ni josef o da vwe ero te o de vwo mu osun re uwevwi roye kugbe emu ro vwori ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ghwe ne ọke re vwo mu osun rẹ uwevwi rọye kugbe obo ro vwori ejobi, Ọrovwohwo de bruphihọ uwevwi rẹ ohwo rẹ Ijipt na fiki ri Josẹf, ebruphihọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo da enu rẹ emu ro vwori ejobi, te uwevwi te ẹghwa.
verses.text_romanized: ghwe ne oke re vwo mu osun re uwevwi roye kugbe obo ro vwori ejobi orovwohwo de bruphiho uwevwi re ohwo re ijipt na fiki ri josef ebruphiho re orovwohwo da enu re emu ro vwori ejobi te uwevwi te eghwa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ọ da yan jobo ro vwori ejobi vwo ki Josẹf, ro vwo jẹn ayen vwo kẹ nu ọ gbe ro ẹnwa rẹ emuọvo jokpa re obo rọ ria ọvo. Josẹf re dje na ohwo erhuvwu gangan.
verses.text_romanized: koye o da yan jobo ro vwori ejobi vwo ki josef ro vwo jen ayen vwo ke nu o gbe ro enwa re emuovo jokpa re obo ro ria ovo josef re dje na ohwo erhuvwu gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Ọmọke vwọ wan nure aye rẹ onini rọye na kọ vwẹ ẹro guọnọ Josẹf, ọ da ta, Mọ ra vwerhẹ.
verses.text_romanized: omoke vwo wan nure aye re onini roye na ko vwe ero guono josef o da ta mo ra vwerhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da se ọ da ta kẹ aye rẹ onini rọye na, Nighe, Me vwọ herọ na onini mẹ gbe ro ẹnwa rẹ emuọvo-o, o de phi kemu kemu na ejobi phihọ ovwẹ obọ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da se o da ta ke aye re onini roye na nighe me vwo hero na onini me gbe ro enwa re emuovo o o de phi kemu kemu na ejobi phiho ovwe obo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ rhonọ vwẹ vwẹ uwevwi na-a, eyẹ o si emuọvo nu kẹ vwẹ-ẹ jokpa wẹ ọvo, fikiridie wẹ aye rọye, komavọ mi ru emu ọbrabra nana, ri mi ru umwemwu kpahe Ọghẹnẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o rhono vwe vwe uwevwi na a eye o si emuovo nu ke vwe e jokpa we ovo fikiridie we aye roye komavo mi ru emu obrabra nana ri mi ru umwemwu kpahe oghene

verses.text_urhobo: Dede na ọ ta ki Josẹf kẹdẹ kẹdẹ na, jẹn ọ davwerhọ rọye-e, ro vwo nene shevwerhẹ eyẹ ro vwo si kẹrẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: dede na o ta ki josef kede kede na jen o davwerho roye e ro vwo nene shevwerhe eye ro vwo si kere e

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ẹdẹ ọvo, ri Josẹf vwọ ro uwevwi re ru iruo re jẹn ohwo ọvuọvo uwevwi-i.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ede ovo ri josef vwo ro uwevwi re ru iruo re jen ohwo ovuovo uwevwi i

verses.text_urhobo: O de shabọ phihọ ewun rọye, tanẹ, Mọ ra vwerhẹ Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da djẹ je ewun rọye vwo kẹ, ọ da djẹ ro otafe nẹ evun rẹ uwevwi na.
verses.text_romanized: o de shabo phiho ewun roye tane mo ra vwerhe ekevuovo o da dje je ewun roye vwo ke o da dje ro otafe ne evun re uwevwi na

verses.text_urhobo: Rọ vwọ mrẹ nẹ Josẹf djẹ jẹ ewun rọye vwo kẹ rọ da dje ro otafe,
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo mre ne josef dje je ewun roye vwo ke ro da dje ro otafe

verses.text_urhobo: o de se ihwo rẹ uwevwi na rhe ọ da ta kẹ ayen, No, ọshare mẹ reyọ ohwo ri Hibru rhe ohri rẹ avwanre re ọ rhe phọphọ avwanre; o de bru vwe rhe ri sherhẹ, Mi de kperi gangan,
verses.text_romanized: o de se ihwo re uwevwi na rhe o da ta ke ayen no oshare me reyo ohwo ri hibru rhe ohri re avwanre re o rhe phopho avwanre o de bru vwe rhe ri sherhe mi de kperi gangan

verses.text_urhobo: ọke ro vwo nyo nẹ mi bunu, ọ da yan jẹ ewun rọye vwo kẹ vwẹ, ọ da djẹ nẹ uwevwi ro otafe.
verses.text_romanized: oke ro vwo nyo ne mi bunu o da yan je ewun roye vwo ke vwe o da dje ne uwevwi ro otafe

verses.text_urhobo: O de si ewun na nu bẹsiẹ rẹ onini rọye vwọ rhe uwevwi,
verses.text_romanized: o de si ewun na nu besie re onini roye vwo rhe uwevwi

verses.text_urhobo: o de gbe ikun ọvuọvo na kẹ tanẹ, Odibo rẹ ohwo ri Hibru ru wọ reyọ rhe ohri rẹ avwanre, o de bru vwe rhe re phọphọ ovwẹ;
verses.text_romanized: o de gbe ikun ovuovo na ke tane odibo re ohwo ri hibru ru wo reyo rhe ohri re avwanre o de bru vwe rhe re phopho ovwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Me ghwa vwọ kpare urhuru mi che vwo bunu, ọ da yan je ewun rọye vwo kẹ vwẹ, ọ da djẹ ruafe.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo me ghwa vwo kpare urhuru mi che vwo bunu o da yan je ewun roye vwo ke vwe o da dje ruafe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ onini rọye vwo nyo eta rẹ aye rọye ta kẹ, Ọnana obo rẹ odibo wẹn phọphọ ovwẹ, ophu de muo gangan.
verses.text_romanized: oke re onini roye vwo nyo eta re aye roye ta ke onana obo re odibo wen phopho ovwe ophu de muo gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Onini ri Josẹf ghwa reyọ o de re muo phihọ uwodi, asan ra da karọ ekru rẹ ovie, kẹ Etiyin a kaerọ phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: onini ri josef ghwa reyo o de re muo phiho uwodi asan ra da karo ekru re ovie ke etiyin a kaero phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọrovwohwo vi Josẹf herọ ivun rọye da vwerhọ, ọ da vwẹ aruesiri kẹ vwẹ obaro rẹ olori rẹ uwodi na.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo orovwohwo vi josef hero ivun roye da vwerho o da vwe aruesiri ke vwe obaro re olori re uwodi na

verses.text_urhobo: Olori rẹ uwodi na da vwi kemu kemu rẹ uwodi na ejobi te ihwo vwọ kẹ Josẹf yọnre, obo re ruru ejobi ọye ri ru ayen.
verses.text_romanized: olori re uwodi na da vwi kemu kemu re uwodi na ejobi te ihwo vwo ke josef yonre obo re ruru ejobi oye ri ru ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Olori rẹ uwodi na rha davwerhọ rẹ obo ra vwọ kẹ Josẹf yọnre na-a, kidie Ọrovwohwo vọye herọ; kemu kemu ro ruru ejobi, Ọrovwohwo da nẹrhẹ oyovwi.
verses.text_romanized: olori re uwodi na rha davwerho re obo ra vwo ke josef yonre na a kidie orovwohwo voye hero kemu kemu ro ruru ejobi orovwohwo da nerhe oyovwi
